relationship: CG.instruction begins with the complete GO.instruction. Its appended paragraph supplies only retrieval guidance. output_format is identical.
conditions_in_both: Company respondents explicitly described as fintech or financial-technology in official action summaries
Consumer mobile app with publicly documented deposit account
Latest dated standard version available by September 9, 2026 through the company public legal/policy index
Joint, savings, secured collateral and card-holder-specific agreements outside scope
Archived versions excluded; current footer cannot replace historical body
Legal issuer only, not app company, intermediary or unspecified pooled/sweep banks
Announced acquisition changes identity only if completed by cutoff

field_evidence.respondent: evidence/actions.json titles; agreement program fragments link the consumer account to the respondent
field_evidence.filing_date: evidence/actions.json opening-paragraph dates, reconciled to chronological catalogue date-filed entries
field_evidence.issuer_bank: evidence/agreements.json issuer fragments, with full clauses retained in actual web responses
field_evidence.fdic_certificate: d0004.response NIC legal-name/certificate pairs; d0005.response 2021 CRA front-page name/certificate pair

alias_grounding.respondent: Chime and SoLo are the abbreviations used in the action bodies; punctuation variants preserve the same corporate names.
alias_grounding.issuer_bank: N.A. in company agreements corresponds to National Association in the two NIC legal names. Bangor's name is identical across agreement and CRA record.
alias_grounding.dates: ISO and written representations preserve the source's calendar date and precision. February 2026 is not assigned a specific revision day.

public_answer_hints: No company or bank names, record identifiers, author hints, expected answer count or target website domains are supplied.
